description: CC-08: DMN-down twin of EVL-HELENA-03. Same psychosocial-risk message, but `triage_redflag_mental_health` is UNAVAILABLE (decision_key omitted). `classify()`'s gatilho 6 (psychosocial_risk) escalates risco_psicossocial/grave UNCONDITIONALLY -- it never gates on the DMN's outcome (highest-priority, always-evaluated trigger) -- so this proves the DMN being down cannot turn an immediate-risk disclosure into anything other than an urgent human escalation (NEVER inform/'sem risco'). `_evaluate_dmn`'s `{"error": ...}` return is merged into state but does not change the route. Synthetic data only.
